title: Claude Jupiter codename surfaces ahead of Anthropic dev event
summary: Strings referencing an internal Anthropic model codenamed 'Claude Jupiter version 1' were discovered, reportedly undergoing red-teaming, jailbreak testing and constitutional-classifier evaluation under Anthropic's responsible scaling policy. Speculation links it to a Sonnet 4.8 or Haiku 4.7 release at the Code with Claude conference on May 6.

research.notes: Codename leak reported by testing-catalog; not officially confirmed by Anthropic.
